senses.gloss:
जुहू 1. जुहू, ऊस्, f. (fr. rt. ह्वे), a tongue;
especially the tongue or tongues of Agni, the flames;
सप्त जुह्वः, the seven tongues of Agni; see जिह्वा.
जुहू personified is the wife of Brahmā and goddess
of speech; [cf. सरस्वती.]
—जुहू-वत्, आन्, m. fire
or its deity Agni.
—जुह्व्-आस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
tongue-mouthed, whose mouth consists of tongues
or is full of them, an epithet of Agni.

जुहू 2. जुहू, ऊस्, f. (fr. rt. हु), a wooden
ladle or vessel of the shape of a semicircle or crescent,
used for pouring the sacrificial butter into the fire;
that part of the frame enshrining the supreme spirit
which faces the east.

जुहूराण, अस्, m. (a corrupt form), fire; a sacri-
ficing priest; the moon.

जुहुवाण जुहुवाण, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हु; a cor-
rupt form), fire, (also spelt जुहूवाण); a sacrificing
priest.

जुहुवान, अस्, m. (perf. part. fr. rt. हु), fire;
a tree; a hard-hearted man.

जुहोति जुहोति, इस्, m. (fr. rt. हु), a technical
name for those sacrificial ceremonies to which the
verb जुहोति and not यजति is applied.
—जुहोत्य्-आदि,
अयस्, m. pl. the roots beginning with हु, to sacrifice,
i. e. the roots of the third class.
जुह्वत्, अत्, अती, अत्, sacrificing, offering oblations.
जुह्वत्, अत्, अती, अत्. See p. 350, col. 1.

जुह्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, sacrificing, offering, present-
ing; accepting (an offering, Ved.).
